disclaimer.label: Disclaimer
disclaimer.p1: This Disclosure and Barring Service (DBS) online result is a Enhanced Criminal Record Certificate within the meaning of the following sections of the Police Act 1997 (the Act):
disclaimer.heading2: Use of DBS online result information
disclaimer.p2: The information contained in this DBS online result is confidential. All recipients must keep it secure and protect it from loss or unauthorised access.
disclaimer.p3: This DBS online result must only be used under the terms of the DBS Code of Practice and any other DBS guidance. It is particularly important to follow the guidance on fair use of the information showing a conviction or similar information.
disclaimer.p4: DBS will check the compliance of Registered Bodies with this Code of Practice and other guidance.
disclaimer.p5: This DBS online result is issued under Part V of the Act. Part V of the Act creates several offences, including:
disclaimer.bullet3: forgery or alteration of a Certificate
disclaimer.bullet4: obtaining a Certificate under false pretences
disclaimer.bullet5: using a Certificate issued to another person as if it was one’s own
disclaimer.p6: This DBS online result is not evidence of identity and does not establish entitlement to work in the UK.
disclaimer.p7: The personal identity details contained in this DBS online result are those:
disclaimer.bullet6: supplied by or on behalf of the applicant at the time of the application
disclaimer.bullet7: that appear to match any conviction or other details linked to that identity
disclaimer.p8: The information contained in this DBS online result is derived from:
disclaimer.bullet9: other records of those who are unsuitable to work with children and/or adults
disclaimer.p9: The police records are those held on the Police National Computer (PNC). The PNC contains details of:
disclaimer.bullet10: convictions, cautions, reprimands and warnings in England and Wales
disclaimer.bullet11: relevant convictions in Scotland and Northern Ireland
disclaimer.p10: DBS reserves the right to add new data sources. For the most up to date list of data sources searched by DBS please visit
disclaimer.linkText1: the DBS page (opens in a new tab)
disclaimer.p12: DBS also looks at the position being sought by the applicant and may seek other information. Any Other Relevant Information found is disclosed is at the discretion of the Chief Police Officers or those of an equivalent level in other policing agencies.
disclaimer.p13: DBS is not responsible for the accuracy of police records.
disclaimer.p14: If the applicant is aware of any inaccuracy in the DBS online result they should contact the Countersignatory immediately. This is to prevent an inappropriate decision about their suitability. The Countersignatory will:
disclaimer.bullet12: advise how to dispute that information
disclaimer.bullet13: arrange for it to be referred to the DBS on the applicant's behalf
disclaimer.p15: The information should be disputed within 3 months of the date of issue of the DBS online result.
disclaimer.p16: DBS will seek to resolve the matter with the source of the record and applicant.
disclaimer.p17: Sometimes a dispute can only be resolved using fingerprints. The applicant's consent is required for this.
disclaimer.p18: If DBS upholds the dispute DBS will issue a new DBS online result free-of-charge. For details of the DBS disputes and complaints procedures please visit
disclaimer.linkText2: the DBS page (opens in a new tab)
